# ctxcap
Optional offline CLI for measuring context-file tokens and finding stale references.
Run `npx -y ctxcap --json`; it needs no API key, network, telemetry, or configuration.
Use `--plan --budget N` only when a ranked cleanup plan is useful; review edits before applying them.
The MCP server is optional: `npx -y ctxcap-mcp`; counts are approximate (about +/-5%).
